savings  Mandatory rule
Create all required variants

Create all the necessary variant combinations of a component set.


Always use the appropriate token from the ODS foundation.


For example, if you are designing the hover state of a component, for the component colours use tokens from the 'colours/interaction-states/hover' group.



savings  Mandatory rule
standardOnBackground  Checked by plugin
Interaction states

Create variants for all states of an interactive component. The acceptable values for state may include no more than the following:

Standard
Hovered
Pressed
Focused
Visited(web only)
Any other state, such as ‘Disabled’ or ‘Read only’ should be added as a separate variant property with true / false values.


Variants with values true / false appear as a boolean in the component instance property panel.


Foundation colour tokens are grouped by state (e.g., hover, pressed) so that you can always use the correct token for each design case.
